2.1.paragraph: This document outlines the Pro-Vizi provisioning endpoints for the GreenShield platform. By specifying a supported function and providing the necessary data, Pro-Vizi interacts with the GreenShield platform to perform actions without user interface interaction or human intervention.

2.2.paragraph: GreenShield values are organized based on site functionality.

3.1.1.paragraph: The GreenShield endpoint supports the following functions:

table_row: Adds a member with spouse only or dependent(s) only or spouse with dependents.
Searches for a member using specified  filters
Terminates (removes) a member from the plan
